mission_04: Polynomial features capture non-linear relationships by creating interaction terms and powers of existing features. For example, from features x1 and x2, degree-2 polynomial features include x1, x2, x1^2, x1*x2, and x2^2. This allows linear models to fit curved relationships without changing the model itself. In this mission, you will use sklearn's PolynomialFeatures to automatically generate these expanded features, learn to interpret the feature names, and understand how polynomial expansion increases the feature space dimensionality.
